metadata.title: Velyric – the AI voice agent that answers every call
metadata.description: Velyric's AI voice agent answers your calls day and night in English, German and Hungarian, books appointments, and hands over to your team when needed.

brand.tagline: AI voice agents for modern businesses

hero.eyebrow: AI voice agents for modern businesses
hero.titleLine2: day and night, in your language.
hero.subtitle: Velyric's voice agent picks up the phone like your best receptionist: friendly, natural, and it books the appointment right away. You stay focused on your work.

call.t1: Hi! I'd like a haircut tomorrow afternoon.
call.t2: Happy to help! We have 2:00 pm or 4:30 pm tomorrow. Which would you like?
call.t4: Great, you're booked for tomorrow at 2:00 pm. See you then!

personal.title: We come to you and build it around your business.
personal.text: Every business is different. That's why we don't install a template: together we plan what it says, what it knows and when it hands over.
personal.imageAlt: Two people at a table reviewing a document together

visit.title: On-site assessment
visit.text: We visit you and look at who calls, what they ask and when traffic peaks.

tailor.title: Tailoring
tailor.text: We write the conversations in your style — prices, services, opening hours — and connect your calendar.

launch.title: Launch and fine-tuning
launch.text: We test it together, go live, and keep refining it based on real calls in the first weeks.

cta.title: Never miss another call.
cta.text: Show us how your business works — we'll show you how many customers you can win back.

footer.tagline: AI voice agents for modern businesses. Day and night.

demo.title: What a call sounds like
demo.text: A typical call to a dental practice: Velyric finds a slot, then hands a question over to the front desk.
demo.t1: Hello, I need a teeth cleaning next week.
demo.t2: Happy to help. We can see you Tuesday at 9:00 am or Thursday at 3:30 pm. Which suits you?
demo.t3: Thursday is good. Does my insurance cover it?
demo.t4: You're booked for Thursday at 3:30 pm. My colleague can answer the insurance question best, I'll put you through.
demo.handoff: Transferred to the front desk, with a summary
demo.note: Illustrative example. Real conversations are tailored to your business.

team.label: About us
team.title: A Hungarian team that's by your side 24 hours a day.
team.clockA11y: 24-hour dial: Velyric answers calls every hour of the day.

team.title: A local team, available 24/7
team.text: People, not a ticketing system. If you have a question, you can reach us day or night.

line.title: A line that's never busy
line.text: Your Velyric line answers every hour of the day, on weekends and holidays too.

devs.title: Expert developers, built around you
devs.text: Our engineers build the voice agent for your business: your services, prices, tone of voice and calendar.

industries.label: Solutions
industries.title: Built for your industry.
industries.text: A salon takes calls differently from a practice or a workshop. Pick yours and see how Velyric would work for you.

page.callTitle: What a call sounds like at your place

salon.name: Beauty salons
salon.card: Answers the phone even while you're colouring, and books straight into your calendar.
salon.metaTitle: AI phone assistant for beauty salons
salon.metaDescription: Velyric answers your salon's calls, books appointments into your calendar and handles cancellations while you focus on your client. Day and night.
salon.title: You focus on the client. We answer the phone.
salon.text: For hair salons, beauticians and nail studios: Velyric answers calls, books appointments into your calendar and handles cancellations while you work.
salon.img1Alt: Hairdresser styling a client's hair in a bright salon
salon.img2Alt: Bright salon reception with product shelves and clients

a.title: It rings while you're colouring
a.text: You can't put the brush down for a call, and the client books elsewhere.

b.title: Evening and weekend calls
b.text: Most people call after work, when the salon is already closed.

c.title: Cancellations, empty chairs
c.text: A forgotten cancellation is a lost hour, and rebooking means more calls.

a.title: Books into your calendar
a.text: It sees free slots and knows service lengths: a colour takes longer than a cut.

b.title: Rescheduling and cancelling
b.text: When someone cancels, the slot is freed in your calendar right away.

c.title: Prices and services
c.text: Answers common questions with your own price list.

d.title: By stylist, too
d.text: If a client wants their usual stylist, it looks for space in that calendar.

call.t1: Hi, I'd like a colour and cut with Réka on Thursday.
call.t2: Réka has two and a half hours free from 10:00 am on Thursday. Does that work?
call.t4: You're booked with Réka on Thursday at 10:00 am, colour and cut. See you then!

salon.ctaTitle: Give your salon a voice of its own.
salon.ctaText: We look at how your salon works and tailor Velyric to it.

clinic.name: Practices and clinics
clinic.card: Books and moves appointments, so your front desk can focus on patients.
clinic.metaTitle: AI phone assistant for practices and clinics
clinic.metaDescription: Velyric answers your practice's calls, books and moves appointments, and always passes medical questions to your staff. Day and night.
clinic.title: Fewer rings at the front desk. More attention for patients.
clinic.text: For dental, private and specialist practices: Velyric answers calls, books and moves appointments, and always puts medical questions through to your staff.
clinic.img1Alt: Dentist talking with a patient in a bright practice
clinic.img2Alt: Dental assistant treating a patient in a modern practice

a.title: Everyone calls at opening time
a.text: The line is busy in the morning and patients keep trying again.

b.title: The front desk can't be in two places
b.text: A patient waits at the desk while the phone keeps ringing.

c.title: Check-ups and rescheduling
c.text: Most calls are routine, yet each one needs a person.

a.title: Booking and moving
a.text: Finds free slots based on your hours and treatment length.

b.title: Medical question? Transferred.
b.text: It never gives medical advice: every clinical question goes to your staff, with a summary.

c.title: Hours and what to bring
c.text: Explains opening hours, what patients should bring and how to find you.

d.title: Only the data it needs
d.text: It asks only what the appointment requires, nothing more.

call.t1: Hello, I'd like to move my check-up next week.
call.t2: Of course. We can see you Tuesday at 8:30 am or Wednesday at 2:00 pm. Which suits you?
call.t4: I've moved you to Wednesday at 2:00 pm. Please bring your insurance card.

clinic.ctaText: We visit your practice and tailor Velyric to your schedule.

restaurant.name: Restaurants and cafés
restaurant.card: Takes table bookings even at peak time, and answers questions on hours, menu and parking.
restaurant.metaTitle: AI phone assistant for restaurants and cafés
restaurant.metaDescription: Velyric answers your restaurant's calls, takes table bookings even at peak time and answers questions about the menu and opening hours. In three languages.
restaurant.title: Full house on Friday. The phone still gets answered.
restaurant.text: For restaurants, bistros and cafés: Velyric answers booking calls, reserves tables and handles common questions while you look after your guests.
restaurant.img1Alt: Busy, bright restaurant with guests and a server
restaurant.img2Alt: Smiling café owner in front of the counter

a.title: Nobody free at peak time
a.text: Most calls come in exactly when the room is fullest.

b.title: The same questions again
b.text: Any tables tonight? How late are you open? Anything gluten-free?

c.title: Lost bookings
c.text: A missed call is an empty table and a guest who goes elsewhere.

a.title: Table booking
a.text: Books by party size and time, and suggests another time when you're full.

b.title: Menu, allergens, hours
b.text: Answers from your own menu and rules.

c.title: Groups and events
c.text: For larger parties or events it transfers to the person in charge, with a summary.

d.title: Several languages
d.text: Speaks German and English with tourists too.

call.t1: Good evening, I'd like a table for six tomorrow at seven.
call.t2: Seven is fully booked, but there's a table for six on the terrace at 7:30. Would that work?
call.t4: You're booked for tomorrow at 7:30, six people, on the terrace. See you then!

restaurant.ctaTitle: Turn every call into a booking, not an empty table.
restaurant.ctaText: We look at when your phone rings most and tailor Velyric to it.

auto.name: Auto repair shops
auto.card: No more running to the phone with oily hands: it answers and books the service slot.
auto.metaTitle: AI phone assistant for auto repair shops
auto.metaDescription: Velyric answers your workshop's calls, books service appointments and notes what's wrong with the car while you work. Day and night.
auto.title: You're under the bonnet. Velyric is on the phone.
auto.text: For garages, tyre shops and workshops: Velyric answers calls, books service appointments and notes what's wrong with the car.
auto.img1Alt: Smiling mechanic in a bright workshop
auto.img2Alt: Mechanic working in a car's engine bay

a.title: You can't phone with oily hands
a.text: A mechanic can't drop the job, and the caller won't wait.

b.title: Seasonal call floods
b.text: In tyre season the phone rings all day.

c.title: "When will it be ready?"
c.text: So many calls are about the same thing, and each one breaks focus.

a.title: Service booking
a.text: Notes the plate, model and problem, and books a free slot.

b.title: Tyre season
b.text: Answers every call even at peak time and hands out free slots.

c.title: Questions about a repair
c.text: Transfers to the mechanic or requests a callback on the caller's behalf.

d.title: Prices only from your list
d.text: Quotes only prices you've given it; everything else goes to your staff.

call.t1: Hello, I need a tyre change next week for a Skoda Octavia.
call.t2: Happy to help. Monday at 8:00 am or Tuesday at 1:00 pm is free. Which would you like?
call.t4: Booked for Monday 8:00 am: Skoda Octavia, tyre change. See you then!

auto.ctaTitle: Stop losing jobs to the phone.
auto.ctaText: We visit your workshop and tailor Velyric to how you work.
